collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: During a village feast, a cook realizes that the night fishers will not be back until after all the food is gone.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: During a village feast, (name1), a cook, realizes that the night fishers will not be back until after all the food is gone.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

choices.label: Ask Everyone to Leave a Little.
Save the Best Part for Them.
Hold a Second Small Feast When They Return.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The fishers return to warm food and are touched that someone remembered.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The portions grow cold, but the fishers are glad to eat anything at all.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Each family leaves a share, and the fishers end up with a small feast.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Some families forget, so the cook makes up the difference from the pot.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The fishers are delighted by the choice pieces.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Someone else eats the best part by accident, and the cook has to laugh.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The late celebration becomes a happy tradition.

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Most villagers are asleep, but the fishers and the cook share a cozy meal.
